recipe.visualDefinition: A chaotic, layered collage of torn and overlapping lined notebook pages filled with frantic, all-caps handwriting in black ink, interspersed with small, square instant-film photographs showing a solitary figure in a dark, minimalist setting.
coreVisualRelationships: Overlapping layers of paper creating depth and texture
Contrast between the structured lines of the paper and the erratic handwriting
Small, dark photographic anchors against the bright white paper background
Visual tension between organized journaling and emotional outbursts

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Decentralized; multiple focal points created by the scattered photos and larger, bolder text blocks.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central Polaroid and the largest, most aggressive handwriting block near the center-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular and erratic; the eye jumps between the dark photos and the varying sizes of the handwritten text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with overlapping elements, leaving only small slivers of the background visible.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with extremely low saturation, creating a bleak, clinical, yet raw atmosphere.

letterConstructionRules: Inconsistent baseline following the paper lines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Over-emphasized, larger glyphs for emotional emphasis
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying the scale and weight of the same handwriting style to create internal hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Simple line drawings (e.g., a noose or scribbles)

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the raw, urgent feel of the original text.
Matches the ink bleed and stroke consistency of the smaller text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a top-down collage of scattered, overlapping torn pieces of lined notebook paper. Include three small, square instant-film photographs showing a person in dark, moody, minimalist poses. The lighting should be flat and clinical.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add handwritten all-caps text in black ink across the paper. Vary the size of the text, with some phrases appearing large and aggressive and others appearing as small, dense blocks of journaling. Include occasional scribbles and strikethroughs.

verificationChecks: Are the paper lines visible and blue/red?
Are the photos framed in white Polaroid-style borders?
Is the overall mood raw and unpolished?

adjustableVariables: Degree of paper tearing and overlapping
mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on the paper
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is perfectly horizontal or vertical.
Check that the ink appears to bleed slightly into the paper fibers.
Verify that the photos look like physical objects placed on the paper.
Confirm the absence of digital-looking gradients.
recipe.reuseFormula: Layered Lined Paper + Scattered Instant Photos + Raw All-Caps Handwriting = Emotional Journal Collage
